title: Cover pipeline timeouts and a later stage that cannot start in `runSliceChecks`

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Raised by the reviewer in round 1 of ork run ork-20261128-034159-7b668596 for S524 (discovered from S524):

Cover pipeline timeouts and a later stage that cannot start in `runSliceChecks`
No test reaches these branches at states.go:1221-1224 and 1229-1230:
- the shared time running out between stages;
- a stage timing out mid-pipeline;
- a later stage, such as a missing `rg`, failing to start, which should pause the run.

The spec's failing-test list did not ask for these tests, so this is not a fix for this slice.
